sermon.title: The Holy Spirit in the Old Testament is the Same Holy Spirit in the New Testament 09/14/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows that the same Holy Spirit works in both Testaments. The Spirit turned Saul into another man, but Saul ignored God’s timetable, spared Agag, persecuted David and lost the Spirit. Paul, chief of sinners, was born again, taught by the Spirit and became the chief apostle. The same Spirit is offered to all of us.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words.
